bundle.shortDescription: The King James Bible with the master engravings, offline.
bundle.longDescription: The Scriptures: the whole King James Bible with resolved cross-references, the words of Christ in red, the Orthodox lectionary and 217 public-domain master engravings by Gustave Doré, Albrecht Dürer and Titian. Works offline; nothing is sent anywhere.
